HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ JAIN  ORDER % 26.02.2026 1.

A charge sheet for commission of offences under section 498A/406/34 of the IPC was presented before the concerned court and, in such charge-sheet, accused Amit Kumar (husband) was kept in Column No. 11, but other relatives of the complainant i.e. Mr. Jai Singh Badgujar (father-in-law),
Mrs. Savitri Devi (mother-in-law), Mr. Vikas Kumar (brother-in-law), Mrs. Ruby (sister-in-law) and Mrs. Seema (sister-in-law)

kept in Column No.12.
2.

According to prosecution, there was no evidence against the accused named in Column No.12.
3.
However, when the above said charge sheet was considered by the learned court, while taking cognizance, all such accused persons shown in Column No.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 02/03/2026 at 20:39:40 12 have also been summoned.
4. The challenge is to the above said order, whereby, all such persons shown in Column No. 12 have been summoned.

It is submitted that the order has been passed in a mechanical manner and no reason has been given as to why they have been summoned, particularly when they were residing at different floor/different place.
5. The present petitions are by all such persons shown in Column No. 12 and they seek quashing of FIR No. 0032/2023, registered at P.S. Prashant Vihar.

6. Learned APP for the State appears on advance notice and the learned counsel for respondent no.
2 has also joined the proceeding through video-conferencing on advance notice.
